title: Machine learning finds episodic memory MRI biomarkers for Alzheimer's diagnosis
summary: A relevance vector regression found MRI features that predicted episodic memory in 143 patients with amnesic mild cognitive impairment (r=0.638), mostly in default mode and limbic networks. A support vector machine on these features separated Alzheimer's patients from controls with more than 86% accuracy across two independent datasets (N=994), and the regions showed amyloid PET differences among groups.
ai_technology: Relevance vector regression feature identification with a support vector machine classifier
organization: Zhongda Hospital Southeast University; Southeast University

evidence.tested: Two independent datasets (N=994) with CSF and amyloid PET correlates.
evidence.unknown: Modest accuracy; retrospective; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Machine learning identified imaging features and classified diagnosis.
